name: tokenized-fractional-load-test
description: End-to-end load testing suite (Artillery) for the Tokenized Fractional order-matching engine, trade-order REST endpoints, and WebSocket fan-out (Issue #524).

scripts.test:smoke: artillery run artillery/smoke.yml --output reports/smoke.json && artillery report reports/smoke.json --output reports/smoke.html
scripts.test:orders: artillery run artillery/trade-orders.yml --output reports/trade-orders.json && artillery report reports/trade-orders.json --output reports/trade-orders.html
scripts.test:websocket: artillery run artillery/websocket.yml --output reports/websocket.json && artillery report reports/websocket.json --output reports/websocket.html
scripts.test:full: artillery run artillery/full-suite.yml --output reports/full-suite.json && artillery report reports/full-suite.json --output reports/full-suite.html
